summary: Serves /notebook/ by importing site-astro/src/notebook-page.html (generated by scripts/kb-viewer/build-site-page.mjs) via a `?raw` import and inlining it through a bare `<Fragment set:html>`, the same pattern as /graph/. It strips the generated file's own leading `<!doctype html>` since Astro emits its own ahead of the template. It also adds an explicit `<meta charset="utf-8">` before the fragment that the graph route does not need: the kb-view template has no charset meta because it is designed to be opened as a local file (where browsers default to UTF-8), but served over HTTP without one the note text (em dashes etc.) gets mis-decoded as Latin-1 — a site-only fix, the generated template itself stays correct for its actual local-file use.
